title: 8. Advanced Techniques
use_cases: Use when a story requires multiple layers of perspective through a specific character frame
Implement when repeating key phrases is necessary to reinforce specific narrative themes
Configure when switching between past and present timelines to differentiate character voices
Use when the narrator needs to engage in self-reflection regarding the act of storytelling
content:
| Technique | Use Case | Narrative Framing | A narrator frames a story told by another character, adding layers of perspective. | Voice Echoing | Repeating key phrases across different voices to reinforce themes. | Temporal Voice Shifts | Switching voice when moving between past and present timelines. | Meta‑Narration | The narrator comments on the act of storytelling itself, creating a self‑reflective layer. |
